memory_note: Counting system allocator requested bytes; atomic instrumentation included identically in all variants. RSS measured by parent; not allocator usable size.

store_census.accounting: Requested capacities, excluding allocator rounding, tree node overhead, and engine state outside DocumentStore. The *.unused entries are subsets of *.capacity; *.payload entries are lower bounds. Shared dictionaries and positions are counted once. Census scratch is excluded.
